messages:
Alex W: Heads-up — the Node quickstart in README still shows old constructor and env var REDWOOD_KEY. New SDK expects REDWOOD_API_KEY and `new RedwoodClient({ apiKey })` so copy/paste breaks during onboarding.
Maya R: Ugh, saw a couple users hit that yesterday in support. Which file path?
Alex W: docs/quickstarts/node/README.md — lines around the sample app. Snippet currently:
```js
const { RedwoodClient } = require('redwood')
const client = new RedwoodClient(process.env.REDWOOD_KEY)
```
It should be:
```js
const { RedwoodClient } = require('@redwood/inference')
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })
```
Also the snippet doesn't show retry behavior — we should include example for `retry` option.
Sam (devex): Can you open a tiny PR? I can do a quick review and merge. Also add a note about auth env var name in the table of envs.
Alex W: Created draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/456 — includes snippet fix + note. Please check the retry bit: I added `retry: { maxRetries: 2, backoff: 300 }` suggestion.
Olga: Quick nit — update package import across the repo to `@redwood/inference` usages. Search/replace is safe.
docs-bot: Preview deployed at https://deploy-preview-456--redwood-docs.netlify.app/ ✅
Maya R: Nice. After merge, let's backport to the sample app repo and cut a release so samples in the CLI generator match.
Sam (devex): I'll handle backport and raise release PR. Thanks Alex!
